Card Q&A.q: Does the "When this card is trashed from your deck, delete 1 of your opponent's level 3 or lower Digimon" effect also include this card itself in the number of cards in my trash?

Effect: When this card is trashed from your deck, delete 1 of your opponent's level 3 or lower Digimon. For every 10 cards in your trash, increase the highest level this effect can choose by 1.
[When Digivolving] Unsuspend this Digimon. If you have 20 or more cards in your trash, gain 3 memory.
